lines.zh: 我拖着三格半高的身体移动
lines.en: I move a body three and a half blocks tall.

lines.zh: 走过的地方潮气不散
lines.en: The damp does not lift where I pass.

lines.zh: 三个头各看一个方向
lines.en: Three heads, each watching a different way.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很沉，像海水压下来
lines.en: My steps fall heavy, like seawater pressing down.

lines.zh: 骨头之间长着珊瑚
lines.en: Coral grows between my bones.

lines.zh: 我沿着海岸线走，陆地在退
lines.en: I walk the shoreline, and the land recedes.

lines.zh: 每一步都在渗水
lines.en: Water seeps with every step.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，岩石在我脚下碎
lines.en: I do not detour; rock crumbles beneath me.

lines.zh: 我的影子像一棵珊瑚树
lines.en: My shadow looks like a coral tree.

lines.zh: 海雾跟着我走
lines.en: The sea fog follows me.

lines.zh: 我悬起一点，离地半格
lines.en: I lift a little, half a block off the ground.

lines.zh: 三个头轮流发出一种声音
lines.en: Three heads take turns making one sound.

lines.zh: 我身上滴下来的水是咸的
lines.en: The water dripping off me is salty.

lines.zh: 我感觉到远处的铁傀儡
lines.en: I sense an iron golem far away.

lines.zh: 我数着这片陆地上有多少活物
lines.en: I count the living things on this land.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让草变灰
lines.en: My breath turns the grass grey.

lines.zh: 海嗣的组织在我体内生长
lines.en: Seaborn tissue grows inside me.

lines.zh: 我不需要食物，只需要吞下
lines.en: I need no food, only to swallow.

lines.zh: 风从海上吹来，我没有动
lines.en: Sea wind comes in; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我头顶的骨刺上挂着藻
lines.en: Algae hang from the spikes on my head.

lines.zh: 村民的灯火让我不舒服
lines.en: Village lights make me uneasy.

lines.zh: 我在听海水退去的声音
lines.en: I listen to the sea retreating.

lines.zh: 这具身体比它原来更大
lines.en: This body is larger than what it used to be.

lines.zh: 腐烂的地方长出了新的东西
lines.en: New things grow where it rotted.

lines.zh: 我停在这里，地就开始变咸
lines.en: I stop here, and the ground turns salt.

lines.zh: 远处有钟声，我不喜欢
lines.en: A bell rings far off; I do not like it.

lines.zh: 三个头一起转过来
lines.en: All three heads turn to you.

lines.zh: 你的血肉在动，我看得见
lines.en: Your flesh moves; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我不急，你跑不出我的范围
lines.en: I am unhurried; you cannot leave my range.

lines.zh: 五十六格之内，我都能找到你
lines.en: Within fifty-six blocks I can find you.

lines.zh: 我比你高太多，低头才能看你
lines.en: I am far taller; I must look down to see you.

lines.zh: 我身上的盐在响
lines.en: The salt on my body crackles.

lines.zh: 你举起武器，我也不躲
lines.en: You raise a weapon; I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 这具身体被打过很多次
lines.en: This body has been struck many times.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手，珊瑚跟着动
lines.en: I lift a hand, and the coral moves with it.

lines.zh: 你在我的影子里，这很好
lines.en: You are inside my shadow; good.

lines.zh: 你的心跳声，比海浪清楚
lines.en: Your heartbeat is clearer than the surf.

lines.zh: 你的热气在海底很清楚
lines.en: Your warmth is clear even on the seafloor.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，水洒了一地
lines.en: I step back, water spilling everywhere.

lines.zh: 这一下打进我的组织里
lines.en: That blow went into my tissue.

lines.zh: 我三个头都转了过来
lines.en: All three of my heads turn.

lines.zh: 珊瑚碎了一片，会长回来
lines.en: A patch of coral breaks; it will grow back.

lines.zh: 我身上的咸水沸腾了一下
lines.en: The brine on my body boils once.

lines.zh: 这点伤，对五百多点来说不算什么
lines.en: Against all my life, that is little.

lines.zh: 我发出很低的振动声
lines.en: A low vibration comes from me.

lines.zh: 我的护甲凹了一块
lines.en: A plate of my armor dents.

lines.zh: 我知道该先处理谁了
lines.en: I now know whom to deal with first.

lines.zh: 你还活着，这让我记住了你
lines.en: You are still alive; that makes me remember you.

lines.zh: 活的东西靠近，我就会张开
lines.en: When something living comes near, I open.

lines.zh: 我伸出一个头，尝了尝空气
lines.en: One head stretches out to taste the air.

lines.zh: 这些东西，我吞下去就好
lines.en: Such things I simply swallow.

lines.zh: 你举着的，不是食物
lines.en: What you hold up is not food.

lines.zh: 海水也在吃，只是没人看见
lines.en: The sea eats too, unseen.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，不急
lines.en: I drift closer, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我的三个头有一个先动了
lines.en: One of my three heads moves first.

lines.zh: 活物的味道，比死物好
lines.en: Living smells better than dead.

lines.zh: 我不挑，能吞的都吞
lines.en: I am not choosy; whatever can be swallowed is swallowed.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就前进一步
lines.en: You step back, I step forward.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞一面湿墙
lines.en: You hit me like a wet wall.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，只掉了些水
lines.en: I do not budge; only water falls.

lines.zh: 我的护甲硬得不像活的
lines.en: My armor is harder than anything alive.

lines.zh: 三格半的高度，你撞不到我的头
lines.en: Three and a half blocks; you cannot reach my heads.

lines.zh: 我侧身让了半格
lines.en: I shift aside half a block.

lines.zh: 海水的压力把我推了一下
lines.en: The pressure of seawater nudges me.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，我继续往前走
lines.en: You bounce off; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 珊瑚碎片落了一地
lines.en: Coral fragments scatter on the ground.

lines.zh: 这一撞只让我注意到你
lines.en: That bump only made me notice you.

lines.zh: 我低头，把你圈进视线
lines.en: I lower my head and take you into my sight.

lines.zh: 海嗣不需要这种东西
lines.en: The Seaborn has no need for such things.

lines.zh: 我们靠分裂与吞食延续
lines.en: We continue by splitting and devouring.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，只会互相试探
lines.en: When kin meet, they only probe each other.

lines.zh: 这片海已经容不下两个我
lines.en: This sea cannot hold two of me.

lines.zh: 我们共享同一片潮水
lines.en: We share the same tide.

lines.zh: 组织接触时，会融在一起
lines.en: When our tissues touch, they fuse.

lines.zh: 没有声音，只有水在动
lines.en: No sound, only water moving.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在海面上合成一个
lines.en: Our shapes merge on the sea's surface.

lines.zh: 同类之间也会吞食
lines.en: Kin devour kin as well.

lines.zh: 我记住了这个气息，像记住了海
lines.en: I remember this scent as I remember the sea.

lines.zh: 我把东西吸进掌心
lines.en: I draw it into my palm.

lines.zh: 它在我手里立刻变质
lines.en: It decays at once in my hand.

lines.zh: 这点东西，吞下去就够了
lines.en: Such a small thing; swallowing is enough.

lines.zh: 我提起来，看了看，捏碎了
lines.en: I lift it, look, and crush it.

lines.zh: 我把组织收进体内
lines.en: I take the tissue into my body.

lines.zh: 它被海水浸透了
lines.en: Seawater soaks it through.

lines.zh: 我拿它没有别的用处
lines.en: I have no other use for it.

lines.zh: 落下的东西，我都会捡
lines.en: Whatever falls, I collect.

lines.zh: 我把它按在骨刺上
lines.en: I press it onto a bone spike.

lines.zh: 这一件，留给深处
lines.en: This one I leave for the deep.

lines.zh: 村民的血在远处跳
lines.en: Village blood pulses far off.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡的金属声，我听得见
lines.en: I hear iron golem metal clanking.

lines.zh: 你站在我的索敌范围里
lines.en: You are inside my sensing range.

lines.zh: 三个头分别盯着三个方向
lines.en: Three heads cover three directions.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，整个身体都转
lines.en: I turn slowly, the whole body turning.

lines.zh: 这一片活物，都要被吞下
lines.en: Every living thing here will be swallowed.

lines.zh: 我不喊，我直接压过去
lines.en: I do not roar; I simply bear down.

lines.zh: 海水替我传回了你的位置
lines.en: The seawater carries back your position.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住海水的压力
lines.en: Your armor will not stop the sea's pressure.

lines.zh: 我选中了你，因为你在动
lines.en: I chose you because you move.

lines.zh: 我不需要速度，我只需要逼近
lines.en: I need no speed, only advance.

lines.zh: 我张开一个头，里面全是牙
lines.en: One head opens, full of teeth.

lines.zh: 你在往岸上跑，岸也是我的
lines.en: You run inland; inland is mine too.

lines.zh: 这片地上没有比我更大的
lines.en: Nothing here is larger than me.

lines.zh: 海嗣的意志指着你
lines.en: The Seaborn's will points at you.

lines.zh: 我把身体立起来，挡住整条路
lines.en: I rear up and block the whole road.

lines.zh: 你手里的火，我不怕
lines.en: The fire in your hand does not frighten me.

lines.zh: 我数清了你还有几步路
lines.en: I have counted how many steps you have left.

lines.zh: 三颗头一起低下来看你
lines.en: All three heads lower to look at you.

lines.zh: 我伸出的头在找角度
lines.en: One head searches for the angle.

lines.zh: 你躲到墙后，墙在变咸
lines.en: You hide behind a wall, and the wall turns salt.

lines.zh: 我的范围很大，你出不去
lines.en: My range is wide; you cannot leave it.

lines.zh: 海水从地下渗出来，跟着我
lines.en: Seawater seeps up from below, following me.

lines.zh: 我不快，但我不会停
lines.en: I am not fast, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 你的铁傀儡倒在那边了
lines.en: Your iron golem lies over there.

lines.zh: 村民的叫声我听见了
lines.en: I hear the villagers crying out.

lines.zh: 三个头分三个方向包过来
lines.en: Three heads close in from three directions.

lines.zh: 你在等我靠近，我就在靠近
lines.en: You wait for me to close in; I am closing in.

lines.zh: 我身上的水滴在地上，像下雨
lines.en: Water drips from me like rain.

lines.zh: 珊瑚在我肩上长高了一截
lines.en: Coral has grown taller on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我抬手，海水跟着涨
lines.en: I raise a hand, and the seawater rises.

lines.zh: 你的武器在抖
lines.en: Your weapon is trembling.

lines.zh: 这片地已经不属于陆地了
lines.en: This ground no longer belongs to the land.

lines.zh: 我停在十步之外，先看你
lines.en: I stop ten paces off and study you.

lines.zh: 你退到海边，海也是我的
lines.en: You retreat to the sea; the sea is mine too.

lines.zh: 我从来不让猎物跑第二次
lines.en: I never let prey run twice.

lines.zh: 你每一次呼吸，我都算着
lines.en: I count every breath you take.

lines.zh: 最后一步，我收了
lines.en: I close the last step.

lines.zh: 我一个头咬下来
lines.en: One of my heads snaps down.

lines.zh: 骨刺扫过，带着海水
lines.en: My bone spikes sweep through, trailing seawater.

lines.zh: 我整只压下去，地面塌了
lines.en: I crush down whole, and the ground gives.

lines.zh: 这一下带着五百多点的重量
lines.en: That blow carries the weight of all my life.

lines.zh: 你被撞退，脚下的土变咸
lines.en: You are knocked back, and the soil turns salt.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你的肩
lines.en: My fingers close on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 海水从伤口灌进去
lines.en: Seawater pours into the wound.

lines.zh: 三张嘴同时张开
lines.en: Three mouths open at once.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只要你在范围内
lines.en: I need not chase; you only need to be in range.

lines.zh: 这一击只是推开你
lines.en: That strike only pushed you back.

lines.zh: 你还能站着，我很意外
lines.en: You are still standing; I am surprised.

lines.zh: 珊瑚在我拳上碎开
lines.en: Coral shatters over my fist.

lines.zh: 我抬手又是一下
lines.en: I raise my hand for another.

lines.zh: 地上留下一个咸水洼
lines.en: A saltwater pool remains where I struck.

lines.zh: 海面隆起，我从中立起来
lines.en: The sea surface bulges and I rise from it.

lines.zh: 空气忽然变得又咸又湿
lines.en: The air turns salt-heavy and wet.

lines.zh: 我从凋零变成现在这样
lines.en: I became this from what the wither was.

lines.zh: 三个头先后睁开
lines.en: Three heads open one after another.

lines.zh: 岸上的草一寸寸变灰
lines.en: The grass on the shore greys inch by inch.

lines.zh: 钟声停了，我来了
lines.en: The bell stops; I have come.

lines.zh: 潮水推着我上岸
lines.en: The tide pushes me ashore.

lines.zh: 珊瑚从我的骨架里长出来
lines.en: Coral grows out of my frame.

lines.zh: 我是被召唤来的，不是自然长成
lines.en: I was summoned, not naturally grown.

lines.zh: 这片陆地，从今天起归海
lines.en: This land belongs to the sea from today.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看到的是远处的村子
lines.en: The first thing I see is a village far off.

lines.zh: 海雾漫上来，盖住了路
lines.en: Sea fog rolls in and covers the road.

lines.zh: 我的脚一落地，地就渗水
lines.en: Water seeps the moment my foot lands.

lines.zh: 风里有盐，也有血的味道
lines.en: The wind carries salt, and blood.

lines.zh: 我慢慢升高，比树高得多
lines.en: I rise slowly, far above the trees.

lines.zh: 下界之星在我胸腔里发亮
lines.en: A nether star glows inside my chest.

lines.zh: 海嗣的意志在这里落下了根
lines.en: The Seaborn's will has taken root here.

lines.zh: 这里的水太浅，但够我开始
lines.en: The water is shallow here, but enough to begin.

lines.zh: 我站定时，四周的声音都没了
lines.en: When I settle, all sound around stops.

lines.zh: 一个新阶段开始了
lines.en: A new stage has begun.

lines.zh: 火烤干我的表面，我抖了抖
lines.en: Fire dries my surface; I shudder.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，砸出一个咸水坑
lines.en: I fall from height and crater a salt pool.

lines.zh: 我自己就是海，水淹不死我
lines.en: I am the sea; water cannot drown me.

lines.zh: 气浪撕开我半边珊瑚
lines.en: The blast tears away half my coral.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的组织，慢慢化开
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my tissue and slowly dissolves.

lines.zh: 那股力在排斥我，像退潮
lines.en: That force repels me like a receding tide.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只想吞下东西
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only want to swallow.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，光顺着水流走
lines.en: Lightning strikes me; light runs along the water.

lines.zh: 连海都不在了，只剩空
lines.en: Even the sea is gone; only emptiness.
